Production PIXEL ART for the existing Sproto fighting game. Crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading. Not smooth vector or painterly art. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete actor facing RIGHT, consistent three-quarter side view. Preserve the reference identity, facial shape, exact eye count, colors, clothing, accessories and slender long torso. Same head, torso and limb proportions in every frame. Exactly two arms and two legs per actor, legs rooted at the LOWEST pelvis below the belly. Low hip, chambered knee and connected ankle for every kick. Never attach legs to the chest. Keep all limbs and feet wholly inside their own cell with generous empty margins; no clipping. Flat solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels, shadows, trails, floating particles or weapons. Worn/held identity accessories must remain attached to body or hand. Extend cropped lower bodies conservatively using matching skin/clothing colors and simple shoes. Complete separate body drawings; no limb cutouts. Both feet need readable soles. No extra subjects.

IDENTITY: The ONE character in reference image 1. Cobalt BLUE round head with large angular swept blue/periwinkle rear top spikes, heavy eyelids around YELLOW almond eyes with small BLACK oval pupils and white glints. Large RED nose and broad curved RED lips above a single smooth YELLOW lower mouth/chin crescent. Narrow YELLOW collar over RED shirt with small blue oval brooch at center. Blue arms and bare hands; red lower suit and simple yellow boots. Toothless smile, not rectangular teeth; no gloves, hat or cape. Exactly one head, two eyes, two arms and two low-rooted legs. Exclude reference background. Match all identity colors consistently. Reference image 2 is the approved combat sheet: match its proportions and pixel style exactly.

Exactly EIGHT separate full-body drawings in a regular 4-column by 2-row grid. A continuous guarded fighting footwork loop, NOT a run. Upper body stays calm, head/torso size constant, hips stay at the same height and same x center. Both fists remain raised. Feet are clearly different on adjacent frames: 0 near foot forward grounded/far foot back grounded; 1 transfer weight to near sole, far heel lifts; 2 far knee passes under low pelvis with far foot lifted; 3 far foot reaches forward while near sole still supports; 4 far foot forward grounded/near foot back grounded; 5 transfer weight to far sole, near heel lifts; 6 near knee passes under low pelvis with near foot lifted; 7 near foot reaches forward ready to plant. No feet crossing through one another, no sliding torso, no detached hips. Each frame has at least one clearly grounded foot. Last frame loops to first. Same complete body and clothing as the combat reference. All clothing, spikes and accessories stay connected. Preserve asymmetry by anatomical side. No text, detached effects, weapons, floating shapes or extra subjects. No white clothing highlights; shading uses the same hue as the colored surface.

Row 1 INTRO: relaxed idle; determined head turn with fists rising; guarded confident stance; settle combat guard.
Row 2 SPECIAL A: low coil; shoulder windup; fully extended straight impact punch; punch retract.
Row 3 SPECIAL B: alternate shoulder strike; retract to cover; two-arm finishing palm thrust to RIGHT; recover combat guard. No floating effects.
